answers.core: This should be core because, in the export to HTML menu, there is already a toggle built into the editor for turning on VK LineEdit support. It would be a shame to waste this almost 100% working version because of autozoom.
answers.workaround: This could be worked around by adding the meta into the game when it loads, which I will do, but enough people are in this boat where this would be a greatly appreciated (and hopefully not too hard) fix.

title: Prevent autozoom when opening virtual keyboard on iOS web exports
